title: Roasted Aubergine Gratin
description: A simple, flavorful gratin dish made with roasted aubergine, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cut the aubergine and baby potatoes into 1/2-inch thick slices.
In a large bowl, mix together the grated cheese, heavy cream, minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
In a separate baking dish, create a layer of aubergine slices.
Top with a layer of baby potatoes, followed by a sprinkle of the cheese mixture.
Repeat this layering process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
